blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Over P27 billion worth of projects were allegedly inserted for former House Speaker Martin Romualdez upon the instructions of late Public Works Undersecretary Maria Catalina Cabral, a witness told the Sandiganbayan on Monday. READ: Cabral attempted suicide at home, says lawyer Peter Paul Cortez, chief of the Department of Public Works and Highways’ (DPWH) programming division, made this known during the bail hearing of Romualdez, who is facing plunder charges stemming from alleged kickbacks worth P7.44 billion.
